lines.t: When the night grows long and the road feels cold
I lift my eyes to the one who holds my soul
In the silence I still hear mercy call
By your hand I rise when I begin to fall
You are my refuge, you are my song
By your truth alone, I can carry on
Yahushua, light my way
Hope unshaken through the darkest day
Yahushua, King of grace
I will stand in your holy embrace
With every breath, with every sigh
My heart belongs to you
Most high
When the storm comes crashing over me
You speak peace and you set me free
In the valley, in the fight, in the flame
I will trust and call upon your name
You are my shelter
You are my strength
Your love will lead me to the end
Yahushua, light my way
Hope unshaken through the darkest day
Yahushua, King of grace
I will stand in your holy embrace
With every breath, with every sigh
My heart belongs to you, most high
Holy, holy, everlasting one
Faithful father, shining like the sun
You restore what was broken in me
Yahushua, you have set me free
Yahushua, I'm awake You are worthy of my praise
Yahushua, King of grace, King of grace I will stand in Your holy embrace
With every breath, with every breath, with every sigh
My heart belongs to you, most high
My heart belongs to you, most high
Yahushua, my forever life
